subject: Copywriting
title: AI-Written Email Copy
description: A fast breakdown of AI-Written Email Copy for builders.

hook.text: Jasper and ChatGPT can draft 100 email variants in minutes. AI writes competent copy faster than any human team.

buildup.text: Early tests show AI-generated subject lines match human performance. For body copy, AI is close but lacks originality.

discovery.text: AI excels at variants: give it one email and it produces 50 A/B test versions. Scale that was impossible before.

twist.text: Readers are developing 'AI fatigue.' They sense generic copy.

climax.text: The future: AI writes the first draft, humans add personality and brand voice. Neither alone is optimal.

punchline.text: AI drafts, humans polish. The combo makes the best email copy.

quiz.question: Where does AI currently excel in email marketing?
options: Generating many A/B test variants quickly
